sources.note: A training-free generate-critique-revise loop over a frozen backbone that stops when the critique emits a CONFIRMED sentinel or a depth cap is hit, measured across nine experiments to show the sentinel halts 82-88% of items at about 2.1 generations, with accuracy flat on BBH and significantly higher on GSM8K and MATH.
sources.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models

sources.note: A security study showing that the hidden chain-of-thought of a black-box reasoning model can be recovered near-verbatim through ordinary API tool-calling, because reasoning state must be retained across tool calls within a turn.
sources.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models

result.definition: A DeepSeek reasoning model used in this archive as an API-accessed backbone whose chain of thought is reachable. It is the frozen backbone of a self-reflection protocol study -- nine experiments over three tool-free benchmarks, where its self-reported numeric confidence proved useless (at or above 0.6 on 100% of first generations) while its discrete CONFIRMED sentinel early-stopped 82-88% of items -- and it is the most extractable of three open-CoT targets in a CoT-extraction study, where an attack reaches 66.4% near-verbatim success against near-zero for prior methods. Both uses treat it as a representative current reasoning model rather than as a subject in itself.
related: hidden chain-of-thought as a model asset
